apps.name: pxd Commander
apps.description: Dual-pane file manager with tabs, fast search, previews, FTP/SFTP and a built-in terminal.

apps.name: pxd Media Manager
apps.description: Moves finished torrents where they belong, builds a poster library and plays your videos and pictures.

apps.name: pxd Audio Switcher
apps.description: Switch speakers, headsets and microphones with a hotkey, or automatically when a game starts.

apps.name: pxd Auto Clicker
apps.description: Tray auto clicker: toggle with a hotkey or hold to spam, with chimes you can hear over full-screen games.

apps.name: pxd Chatter Guard
apps.description: Stops worn keys and mouse buttons from double-typing, with a monitor that suggests the right delay.

apps.name: pxd Startup Scanner
apps.description: Finds everything that starts with Windows, flags suspicious entries and shows what slows boot. Runs as admin.

apps.name: pxd Watermark
apps.description: Drag a watermark over a photo, set position, size, opacity and rotation, then stamp one picture or a whole folder.

apps.name: pxd Diagnostics
apps.description: System info at a glance, plus SFC and DISM repairs and a CBS log filter that pulls out what was fixed.
apps.commandNote: Runs the console edition on any PC with nothing to install: system info, SFC and DISM repairs (as administrator) and the CBS log summary.

apps.name: pxd Windows Tweaks
apps.description: Privacy and performance tweaks with real undo, Windows preferences, app removal, a winget installer, fixes, update modes and DNS. Runs as admin.

apps.name: pxd Event Viewer
apps.description: Ticket-ready PC snapshot plus the event logs in plain English: blue screens, crashes, disk errors, failed updates, with what to try.
apps.commandNote: Runs the console edition on any PC with nothing to install: the same snapshot and problem digest, and it never changes anything.

apps.name: pxd Network Scanner
apps.description: Finds every device on the network and works out what it is: PCs, printers, phones, TVs, routers, NAS, cameras and smart-home gear, with makers, models and open ports.
apps.commandNote: Runs the console edition on any PC with nothing to install: the same scan, device types, filters and export.

apps.name: pxd Uninstaller
apps.description: Uninstalls programs and Store apps the normal way or all the way: shows the folders, registry keys, shortcuts, services, tasks and firewall rules they leave behind so you pick what goes. Batch and forced uninstall, find by window, restore points, quiet command line (pxdu).
apps.commandNote: Runs the console edition on any PC with nothing to install: uninstall programs and Store apps (quietly when possible), then pick which leftovers to remove.

apps.name: pxd Notepad
apps.description: Notes with search as you type across everything, folders inside folders, rich text, pictures you can mark up, tags with icons, line numbers, daily date lines, clickable phone numbers and links, blur for passwords, a writing mode, and encrypted sync between your PCs.

apps.name: pxd Disk Health
apps.tagline: Is a drive about to fail?
apps.description: Every drive with a Good, Caution or Bad verdict and why: temperature, power-on hours, SSD wear and spare, bad, pending and uncorrectable sectors, read and CRC errors, NVMe warnings, every SMART value in plain English, and what to do next.
apps.commandNote: Runs the console edition on any PC with nothing to install: each drive's health, verdict and SMART details.

apps.name: pxd Crash Analyzer
apps.tagline: Which driver caused the blue screen
apps.description: Every blue screen with its stop code in plain English and the driver behind it, read from the minidumps, event log and Windows Error Reporting; repeat offenders first, with the driver's maker, version and date, plus GPU resets and unexpected shutdowns.
apps.commandNote: Runs the console edition on any PC with nothing to install: blue screens, stop codes and the driver behind each (run as administrator to read the dump files).

apps.name: pxd Security Check
apps.tagline: Pass or fail for the security basics
apps.description: Antivirus and Defender, firewall, BitLocker, Secure Boot, TPM, UAC, administrators, Remote Desktop, SMBv1, activation, updates, auto-login, LSA protection, core isolation, SmartScreen, open ports and end of support, each a pass, warning or fail with how to fix it, plus a score. Checks only; changes nothing.
apps.commandNote: Runs the console edition on any PC with nothing to install: a pass or fail for each security basic and how to fix it.

apps.name: pxd Update Fixer
apps.description: Failed updates and their error codes in plain English, stuck services, policies, pauses and space, then the standard reset step by step (services, SoftwareDistribution and catroot2, BITS), with DISM and SFC repairs and a fresh check for updates.
apps.commandNote: Runs the console edition on any PC with nothing to install: why updates fail, then the standard reset (run from an admin PowerShell to fix).

apps.name: pxd Space Analyzer
apps.description: A fast scan of any drive or folder: a folder tree with sizes, a treemap, the biggest files and file types, plus the usual waste (temp files, update caches, Windows.old, crash dumps, browser caches, the Recycle Bin) and a clean-up you confirm item by item.
apps.commandNote: Runs the console edition on any PC with nothing to install: biggest folders and files, the usual waste and a clean-up you confirm item by item.

apps.name: pxd Hardware Monitor
apps.description: Live temperatures, fan speeds, clocks, loads, power and voltages for the CPU, GPU, motherboard, memory and drives, with min, max and graphs, and whether the CPU or GPU is slowing itself down from heat or power limits. CPU and motherboard sensors need the PawnIO driver.
